name: Let Your Word Be Your Word
overview: Scripture calls believers to honor God's name and uphold the integrity of their words, as taking the Lord's name in vain brings guilt (Exodus 20:7). Faith is nurtured through hearing God's word, which cleanses and equips believers for righteous living (Romans 10:17; John 15:3). Our speech should be pure and edifying, ministering grace to others (Ephesians 4:29), while the word of Christ is to dwell richly within us, guiding us in wisdom and mutual encouragement through worship and teaching (Colossians 3:16). This reflects the power and faithfulness of God, for with Him nothing is impossible (Luke 1:37).
